name: Chinese Government Scholarship - Bilateral Program (Type A)
provider: China Scholarship Council (CSC), Ministry of Education of China
nationality_rule: Citizens of countries other than the PRC; apply via home-country dispatching agency (usually Chinese embassy)
academic_rule: Bachelor's: high school diploma; Master's: bachelor's; PhD: master's; must meet host university admission rules
language_rule: Bachelor's: CSCA score; Chinese-taught master's/PhD HSK 4; other-language programs per university
age_rule: Bachelor's under 25, master's under 35, PhD under 40, general scholar under 45, senior scholar under 50
coverage_text: Tuition; free dorm or accommodation subsidy; monthly stipend CNY 2,500 (bachelor), 3,000 (master's/general scholar), 3,500 (PhD/senior scholar); medical insurance CNY 800/yr.
duration: Up to 1 year Chinese language prep plus standard program length

deadline.note: Deadline set by the dispatching authority (Chinese embassy in Tashkent); not found on an official page for 2027.

name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship Program
provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs / Campus France
nationality_rule: International (foreign) students; nominated only by French higher education institutions
academic_rule: Nominated by a French institution based on excellence
age_rule: Master's up to 29; PhD up to 35
coverage_text: Monthly allowance and other benefits per 2027 program rules (amounts not stated on the page read).

deadline.note: Deadline for institutions to submit to Campus France; students apply through their French institution, which sets earlier internal dates. Results from 2027-04-12.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program (Uzbekistan)
provider: U.S. Department of State / U.S. Embassy in Tashkent
nationality_rule: Citizens of Uzbekistan residing in Uzbekistan throughout the application and selection process
academic_rule: Bachelor's degree required; medical graduates cannot pursue direct patient care programs
language_rule: English sufficient for full-time US graduate study; nominees must take TOEFL and GRE/GMAT
work_experience_rule: At least two years of professional experience
coverage_text: J-1 visa support, tuition and fees, health insurance, monthly stipend, books and supplies, international airfare to and from the U.S.

deadline.note: 2027-28 competition closed 2026-06-30. Priority fields: AI/data, STEM for critical minerals, nuclear, aerospace, engineering, energy, agriculture.

name: Global Korea Scholarship for Graduate Degrees (GKS-G)
provider: NIIED, Ministry of Education of Korea
nationality_rule: Citizens of NIIED-designated countries; applicant and parents must not hold Korean citizenship
academic_rule: Prior degree by 31 Jul of intake year; GPA 80%+ or top 20%, or CGPA 2.64/4.0, 2.80/4.3, 2.91/4.5, 3.23/5.0
language_rule: TOPIK 3+ needed to enter degree program (can apply without it)
age_rule: Under 40 (under 45 for current professors from ODA countries)
coverage_text: One-way economy airfare; tuition up to KRW 5m (admission fee by university); Korean language training fees; monthly allowance KRW 5.2m paid quarterly (2026 guidelines).
duration: Master's 3 yrs (1 language + 2), PhD 4 yrs (1 + 3), research 6-12 months

deadline.note: 2026 Embassy Track ran 2026-02-12 to 2026-02-25; University Track Feb-Apr by university. Uzbekistan quotas 2026: Embassy 13, University 12.

name: Italian Government Scholarships for Foreign Students (MAECI)
provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI)
nationality_rule: Foreign citizens of countries listed on the Study in Italy portal (one country of citizenship per application)
academic_rule: Master's (Laurea Magistrale), AFAM, PhD (admission letter) or supervised research; bachelor's not eligible
language_rule: B2 Italian or English depending on programme language; none for PhD/research
age_rule: Degree/AFAM under 28, PhD under 30, research under 40 (at deadline)
coverage_text: EUR 10,800 total for 9 months in three instalments; MAECI health/accident insurance; some universities waive tuition, regional fees payable (2026-27 call).
documents: PhD admission letter or supervisor invitation
renewal: Renewals possible for continuing students with at least 15 CFU

name: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
provider: Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science with Dutch institutions
nationality_rule: Non-EEA nationality; no prior degree from a Dutch institution
academic_rule: Accepted to a full-time bachelor's or master's at a participating Dutch institution
coverage_text: EUR 5,000 paid in the first year of study; not a full-tuition scholarship.

deadline.note: Deadlines set by each participating institution; 2026-27 cycle opened 2025-11-01.

name: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
nationality_rule: Citizens of an SI-defined list of eligible countries (41 countries in the autumn-2024 cycle list)
academic_rule: Must apply via University Admissions to an eligible master's programme and be admitted
work_experience_rule: Proof of work and leadership experience; 3,000 hours required for many countries (2024 cycle)
coverage_text: Full tuition; SEK 12,000/month living allowance; insurance against illness and accident; one-time travel grant SEK 15,000 (SEK 10,000 for some countries) (2024 cycle figures).

deadline.note: Current country list not retrievable from si.se; the archived 2024 list did not include Uzbekistan. Window is once a year in February.

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
provider: Swiss Confederation, SERI / Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS)
nationality_rule: Citizens of 183 eligible countries per country list; Uzbekistan offered Research Fellowship and PhD
academic_rule: Master's by 31 Jul 2027 (30 Jun for ETH Zurich); research applicants need a Swiss supervisor
coverage_text: CHF 2,450/month; health insurance (non-EU); CHF 600 rental deposit grant; Half-Fare Travelcard; return flight allowance. Tuition/semester fees not covered.
duration: Research fellowship 6-12 months; PhD 12 months renewable to 36

deadline.note: Uzbekistan deadline 30 Nov 2026, 23:59 Swiss time, via GO ESKAS portal.

renewal: PhD renewable twice subject to progress
